generation.prompt:
Create one editorial illustration for The Daily AI Pulse.
Placement: article hero.
Subject: Give AI Agents a Real Approval Boundary Before They Call Tools.
Verified context: The tutorial treats model-proposed tool calls as untrusted proposals. Application code validates the requested tool and arguments and binds independent approval to the exact proposal and requester. The example records fictional notices in memory; it does not implement a production authorization service.
Visual idea: A folded blank cream task slip stopped just before a narrow slit in a solid terracotta stone partition. A single dark metal removable key rests clearly on the far side on a separate low stone plinth. The keyed mechanism belongs to the partition, the paper cannot open it. Low sculptural architectural assembly, three-quarter view, large negative space; not a workflow diagram.
Output crop: wide landscape 16:9 high resolution. Keep ALL essential objects within central 65 percent of image height so they survive centered 21:9 desktop hero, 16:9 mobile hero and 3:2 card crops.
Use docs/reference-layouts/story.html and actual guide layouts as source of truth. Artwork asset inside existing HTML, not generated webpage.
Art direction: restrained contemporary editorial illustration with quiet scientific/architectural sensibility. Deliberate geometry, fine lines, subtle paper texture, one clear focal idea legible at thumbnail size. Warm canvas #F3EBDD, paper #FAF6EE, near-black #171B1A, muted gray #575D5B, sparing terracotta #8A4B35. Spacious, strong contrast. Substantial tactile stone, paper and dark metal materiality, subtle spatial depth, controlled perspective, asymmetrical commissioned editorial still life; not a bare schematic or flowchart. Fine technical linework supports substantial forms, never the whole composition. Only abstract metaphor, no claim of deployed security or actual software.
No words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, interface elements, buttons, badges, charts, watermark, neon, robots, generic AI brains, diagram, icons, border or frame. No writing on paper.
Deliver a clean high-resolution illustration.
